cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says consumer-protection rules for digital finance are in force; a conduct standard for payment services was being drafted in 2025.
cells.note: Restaged 2026-11-09 on Bill's ruling (message 114), each step met on its own evidence: no consumer-protection rule for digital finance is in force, only the FSCA's planned conduct standard for payment services; the National Financial Ombud taking digital banking fraud complaints was the higher fact.
